// diagnostic

E0381

A `marker` declaration is a retired spelling of a marker type.

What

A `marker` declaration is a retired spelling of a marker type.

Why

A marker is a struct: its fields are the marker's arguments, and its `impl Marker { … }` block gives the marker's settings, its group or its `fn expand(self, target: Target)` template.

Fix

Write `struct Name { field: Type impl Marker { sites :: [.Function] } }`; `jet fix` rewrites the declaration.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0381: tests/ui/marker_decl_rejected_forms.stderr.

Error [E0381]: `marker Traced` is a retired declaration
  --> tests/ui/marker_decl_rejected_forms.jet:6:1
    |
  6 | marker Traced(label: String, $sites: [.Function], $repeatable: true)
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A marker is a struct: its fields are the marker's arguments, and its `impl Marker { … }` block gives the marker's settings, its group or its `fn expand(self, target: Target)` template
 Fix: Declare `struct Traced { … impl Marker { … } }`; `jet fix` rewrites this declaration

    | ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A marker is a struct: its fields are the marker's arguments, and its `impl Marker { … }` block gives the marker's settings, its group or its `fn expand(self, target: Target)` template
 Fix: Declare `struct Fast { … impl Marker { … } }`; `jet fix` rewrites this declaration

Error [E0381]: A trailing `on` clause isn't how a marker states a fact
  --> tests/ui/marker_decl_rejected_forms.jet:10:29
    |
 10 | marker Inline(mode: String) on [.Function]
    |                             ^^
 Why: A marker is a struct whose `impl Marker` block gives its settings, the legal sites among them — not a clause after a parameter list
 Fix: Declare `struct Inline { impl Marker { sites :: [.Function, …] } }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0381

Error [E0381]: A second parameter list isn't how a marker states a fact
  --> tests/ui/marker_decl_rejected_forms.jet:12:30
    |
 12 | marker Pre(condition: String)(sites: [.Function])
    |                              ^
 Why: A marker's arguments are its struct's fields and its facts are the settings of its `impl Marker` block — not two parameter lists
 Fix: Declare `struct Pre { impl Marker { sites :: […]  repeatable :: true } }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0381

Error [E0381]: The checked-text marker declaration is retired
  --> tests/ui/marker_decl_rejected_forms.jet:14:17
    |
 14 | marker Selector on [.Text] {
    |                 ^^
 Why: A marker is a struct whose `impl Marker` block gives its settings; `sites` records legal sites, and checked-text contracts are not a separate marker form
 Fix: Write `struct Selector { impl Marker { sites :: [.Text] } }` for a plain rule, or use a built-in typed text head
